|lore=Able leader and captain of the Avenger. Was given his command by Admiral Ozzel. Treated with suspicion by Darth Vader and the Emperor, who distrust Ozzel's close advisors.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of any starship he pilots. If on Avenger, starship is also immune to attrition &lt; 4. You may re-target applicable Utinni Effects to Needa. If in a battle where you choose to forfeit characters, you must forfeit Needa first.
|joke=Needa owes his command to Admiral Ozzel, and in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' Darth Vader chokes them both to death, Ozzel first; the lore calls it suspicion.<ref name="imsdb-esb">[https://imsdb.com/scripts/Star-Wars-The-Empire-Strikes-Back.html Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back script], IMSDb. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260719123444/https://imsdb.com/scripts/Star-Wars-The-Empire-Strikes-Back.html Internet Archive], 19 July 2026.</ref> It is part of the running gag of cards where Vader chokes his own officers. See [[Jokes#Captain Needa|Jokes]].
